Покупал эти часы в 2017 г. 
Это был мой первый девайс с определением моей активности на руке. Честно говоря носив его, я не ценил, и не осознавал полезности его функционала. В 2022 году они перестали держать заряд. title: The 1.14.7 update causes the app to quit in background while tracking exercise.
body: I used to track my indoors exercise bicycle and watch YouTube at the same time. It worked like magic while you didn’t touch the app for the past 2 years of no updates. Now you destroyed my day to day workflow with the most recent 1.14.7 update – the app quits randomly in the background and the ongoing exercise record is gone forever upon relaunching the app. My Galaxy Fit2 stops tracking my heart rate as well. In 1.14.6 and earlier, the iPhone’s clock turned blue as if Samsung Health was Google Maps during navigation. I suppose it was done to prevent the app being unloaded from the memory. Now it does not do that and I can not track my daily exercise anymore. This is the 5th time this has happened to me this week, and I see no reason to keep using the band and it’s corresponding software anymore.  Judging by your previous updates’ release dates I assume you will fix this in two years time, if ever. Just like you ruined notifications on Galaxy Fit2 around Christmas 2022 and you are yet to release a patch. I’ve been waiting for 2 years now, I feel like I’m being treated as a money bag rather than a client at this point. I regret investing so much into the Samsung ecosystem and I’m looking forward to stop using your software and corresponding hardware completely, since you keep releasing great products and keep ruining them with your useless updates cleverly disguised as “bug fixes” so that we buy your newer stuff that costs an arm and a leg to buy.
